post.summary: Free AI detector check, up to 300 words a day per network, no account

text.description: The text to humanize: plain text, or Markdown when input_format is markdown.

input_format.description: plain (default) or markdown. Markdown keeps headings, bullet and numbered lists, block quotes, fenced code, links (http, https and mailto), bold and italic in the result; anything else is read as plain text, and only the prose is humanized. Word counts and billing use the text without Markdown syntax or link URLs. options.locked_ranges must be empty with markdown.

strategy.description: humanize_only (default) or style_replicate_humanized. The retired rewrite_then_humanize and rewrite_only are accepted and run as humanize_only.

style_id.description: Required for style_replicate_humanized; ignored, and not stored, with any other strategy.

prompt_variant.description: Retired. Accepted so older clients keep working, and ignored: no prompt runs since DL-94.

welcome_offer.description: True when the button showed the welcome back offer ($1 first month of Basic monthly). Without the offer the answer is 410 GONE with details.reason welcome_offer_unavailable, never a Checkout at the full price.

expected_amount_cents.description: The Stripe amount the page showed for this plan and interval (price ladder). When the live price differs the answer is 409 PRICE_CHANGED with details.amount_cents, and nothing is charged. Ignored for the welcome back offer and legacy continuations, which stay on the launch price.

meta_event_id.description: Ad-measurement event id the browser also gave the Meta Pixel (8 to 64 letters, digits, underscore or dash). The server sends the same conversion with this id so Meta counts it once. Optional; it changes nothing else.

choice.description: granted after Allow, denied after No thanks.

text.description: The text to check. The first words that fit the remaining allowance are checked.

id.description: Absent on a notification, which gets no reply (HTTP 202).

method.description: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call, or a notification such as notifications/initialized.

status.description: ok: nothing found. review: see review_items. skipped: no humanized text was checked.

review_items.description: At most 20 notes, the most concrete first.

before.description: The words of your text, or null for something the result adds.

after.description: The words of the result, or null for something it leaves out.

message.description: One plain line, for example: Number changed: "almost two hundred dollars" became "$190".
